about: Every action in the source that removes, deactivates, disables or revokes something (a call to a generated client method whose name says so, or a DELETE request), what the backend does when it runs (hard: the row is deleted; soft: a flag is set and the item stays; archive: a lifecycle is set and nothing shows it; state: a switch with its own verb), and the New rows that carry its words. check-copy.mjs (D12) fails on a call that is not listed, on a listed call the source no longer has, on a backend cite that does not show what the entry says it does, on a soft action whose rows say delete, remove or permanent (the copy says what the product does, C16), on an archive that has no reason, and on a New row with a removal word that no entry or `other` line accounts for.

actions.what: the webhook's Delete: the dialog's button and the row's control
actions.visible: the Inactive tab lists it and the Edit dialog's Status select turns it on again

actions.what: the API token's own Delete token control
Regenerate token: the old token is deleted, then a new one is created
Delete MCP server
Unassign MCP server from a class (the single control)
Unchecking an MCP server in the assignment dialog unassigns it
Remove an entry from the allowlist
Unregister an app
Revoke an app's approved prompt: its own verb, a state the chip shows (Revoked)
Disable an app for a class: set disabled, with its settings kept
Unchecking an app in the enable dialog disables it
Remove users from a class's roster (the enrollment goes, the account stays)
Remove pending enrollments from the roster
Delete material: the code archives it, and no list shows an archived material and nothing restores it, so the person sees a delete
actions.visible: gone from the staff list and from every student's view, with no way back in the product
actions.why: the code archives, but the person can neither see it nor restore it, so Delete is what the page does; A-14.25 says what is kept (the chat history). If an archive list is ever added, relabel in one change.

actions.what: Delete file: its comments, summaries, search index, row and stored file
Replace file: the old stored file is deleted and the index is built again
actions.note: the call is `documentControllerReplaceFile`, an upload, so it is not a removal call the scan reads

actions.what: Delete a comment (a DELETE request from the annotation page)
Delete a summary (a DELETE request from the annotation page)
Delete a chunk from a document's text pieces
An orphaned pipeline helper removes a document's embeddings (no route imports the file: SF-09)
actions.note: `utils/documentPipeline.ts` is on the orphan list of § Scope, so its words are out of scope

actions.what: An embedded app clears its saved state (the app bridge, out of scope)
actions.note: embedded app content is out of scope (G5); the backend cite is only a placeholder for the schema
